pulse.currentFocus: Session 327 made The Desk satire collision-free and production-verifiable. Text-free source art now receives one deterministic masthead/caption layer inside opaque safe zones; duplicate punchlines and visual-description prose are suppressed; scene/alt parity fails closed. Reviewed art is immutable during ordinary scheduled rebuilds and can be overwritten only with explicit refresh authority. The August 23 edition is live after 28/28 seven-theme desktop/mobile reviews and final production inspection. Exact staging and production checks cover 12 pages, 36 assets, newest 2026-08-23, and five claim rows. Build/check is 368 of 368; exact E2E, compliance, mobile, accessibility, and local/staging Lighthouse are green.
pulse.nextMilestone: Bind a deterministic visual-integrity receipt to every newly published Desk story, add a recent-edition visual-diversity memory, and verify the first article to cross the five-pageload privacy floor without lowering it.
blockers: content promotion still depends on a route-provenance probe run from an unchallenged vantage for the PRODUCTION half of the receipt: CI is bot-challenged at the production origin and cannot produce the live route evidence the split-release guard requires. (A CI-reachable build-attestation vantage was added session 322 but deliberately cannot satisfy this gate.)

identity: the provider chain is live and verified (discovery JSON, authorize redirect, JWKS, and the revocation route all answer correctly as of session 321). The production promotion is held only on the real-provider journey, whose remaining leg is a founder passkey ceremony — hardware-key enrollment is founder-reserved by CANON-019 and is deliberately not automatable.
rollback architecture: the GitHub Pages warm origin still follows mutable main; D-S303 requires explicit founder authorization before migrating to an immutable verified generation.
IGNIS freshness: stale in a studio-ops portfolio artifact this repo cannot write; resolve upstream rather than backdating.
The Dispatch has zero confirmed subscribers until the founder clicks the double-opt-in confirmation email.

now: [S327][NEWS/P0] Make AI-generated Desk memes/satire clear, compelling, and collision-free. ✅ Text-free source art now receives one controlled masthead/caption layer with opaque safe zones; duplicate visible punchlines and meta-composition prose are removed; visual parity fails closed; reviewed artwork is immutable during ordinary scheduled rebuilds; 28/28 seven-theme desktop/mobile captures and final production desktop/mobile captures show zero overlap or conflicting text. Production run 32662840244 verified 12 pages, 36 exact assets, the August 23 edition, and five claims.

[S327][OPS/P1] Close the analytics-to-stats closeout dependency. ✅ The canonical derived-build order now regenerates the public Stats surface after analytics and status proof, preventing closeout from creating its own deterministic check-364 drift. Ordering self-test: 15/15.

[S326][NEWS/P0] Complete the Desk recovery deployment and close the claim-ledger release gap. ✅ Production now serves the August 21 and August 22 editions, visible `~1 min` / `Reader views` / `Collecting` labels, daily freshness through August 22, and five August 22 rows from `api/news-desk-claims.ndjson`. The content gate permits only that canonical NDJSON path; arbitrary `api/*.ndjson` and `data/*.ndjson` remain blocked. Verification: hotfix gate 43/43, content lane 63/63, build/check 368/368, staging proof at head `0b5e2bd88`, exact CI green, production run 32605433768.

[S326][SIL][NEWS/P1] Add the canonical claim ledger to the deployment workflow's exact live News verifier. ✅ The shared release contract derives the newest feed item, requires matching fact and stance rows, compares exact candidate/live bytes, and emits ledger counts/hashes. Self-test 7/7; staging and production both verify five August 23 claim rows.

[S326][SIL][NEWS/P2] Extend staging content verification to the newest edition and claims row. ✅ Staging now derives the newest route from the feed and verifies the matching claims date rather than relying on August 7 fixtures. Self-test 15/15; the S327 staging receipt verifies 12 pages, 36 assets, and newest date 2026-08-23.

[S325][SIL:1][NEWS/P1] Prove the first privacy-thresholded article measurements from the repaired publisher. Wait for at least five real browser pageloads on a Desk article, then verify Reader views and measured engaged time replace the honest “Collecting” state without changing the privacy floor or counting UX events as views. The new qualification summary must identify the first qualifying receipt; it currently abstains honestly at zero qualified stories.

[S325][SIL][NEWS/P2] Publish a bounded newsroom-run receipt on `/status/`. ✅ `api/newsroom-run.json` reports observed/abstained state, last run/stage, latest edition, next UTC slot, and public-safe privacy bounds. The live status tile reports `Run observed · latest edition 2026-08-23`.

[S327][SIL][NEWS/P1] Bind a deterministic visual receipt to every newly published story. Record source-master and derivative hashes, compositor safe-zone geometry, and desktop/mobile render evidence in the edition contract so unattended publication proves visual integrity without a paid runtime judge.
next: [NEXT][SIL][NEWS/AI/P1] Claim-evidence relationship map + agent critique packet. Add stable fact rows and validated factRefs joining factual evidence to stances and visual anchors; publish a per-story public-safe argument map and one-click critique packet with no runtime model spend.

[NEXT][SIL][OBS/P1] Field-vitals freshness closure. Surface observed-through/stale-days, restore a fresh post-S262 RUM window, and bind cohort verdicts to a release SHA so fresh generatedAt can never imply fresh field evidence.
